description: Weekly COT history for one market, newest first: open interest and the net position of every trader group (up to 260 reports per call; page back with "until"). Without an account: Legacy, the last 26 reports (6 months). Free account: Legacy, the last 520 reports (10 years). COT Premium and Data API keys: every report family and the full history; COT Premium also adds close prices. A new COT Premium subscription that can still be withdrawn from reads the last year of what Premium adds, until the date in its confirmation e-mail. Both CFTC variants (Futures Only and Futures & Options Combined) with COT Premium and Data API keys; without an account and with a free account, each report's default variant.

from.description: Oldest report date to include, YYYY-MM-DD.

market.description: A CFTC code (e.g. 099741), a ticker (e.g. 6E, GC) or a market name.

report.description: Report family: legacy (default), disaggregated, tff or supplemental.

until.description: Newest report date to include, YYYY-MM-DD (for paging back).

variant.description: CFTC variant: futonly = Futures Only, combined = Futures & Options Combined. Default: the report's own (Legacy: futonly; Disaggregated, TFF: combined; Supplemental is published combined only).

name: get_history
title: COT history for one market
